the Max-Double Exponentially Weighted Moving Average (DEWMA) chart outperforms the Max-Exponentially Weighted moving Average (EWMA) chart for detecting moderate and large shifts in the mean, and moderate shifts in variability.
the Max-Double-EWMA chart outperforms the Max-EW MA chart in detecting small to moderate shifts in the process mean and variance.

the development and analysis of a double EWMA (DEWMA) chart for monitoring process mean and variability.
monitoring the process mean and variance using a single control chart.
developing a monitoring procedure to detect small and moderate shifts of the process mean and variance.

the Max- DEWMA chart outperforms the Max-EW MA chart in terms of the average run length (ARL) and the average time to signal (ATS) in detecting small and medium shifts in the process mean and/or variance.
the Max- DEWMA chart is a better choice in detecting small shifts in the process mean and variance than the Max-EWM chart.
the double EWMA chart is a better choice than the single EWMA chart when monitoring both mean and variance.
